title: Feature: in the terminal UI's Agents panel (projects list), an agent that is in plan mode (`PermissionMode::Plan`) show…
summary: The `(P)` marker is implemented on both the server and UI sides and compiles, but none of the tests are written and the full check command hasn't run. The only check so far is `cargo check -p aura-ui-terminal -p aura-app --all-targets`, which finished with no errors or warnings. An earlier `cargo check` that also covered `aura-ui` and `aura-desktop` passed too, before most of the edits.
